days.file: William Holman Hunt - The Finding of the Saviour in the Temple - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Finding of the Saviour in the Temple
days.alt: Mary bends her face to the boy Jesus and holds him close, while Joseph stands behind with his arm around them both, in the Temple.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s face pressed close to her son’s, and at Joseph’s arm around the boy. What would it mean for your family to find each other again?
days.license: Artist died 1910; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Google Art Project)

days.file: Duccio di Buoninsegna - Last Supper - WGA06786.jpg
days.title: The Last Supper (Maestà, back)
days.alt: At the Last Supper, Jesus sits at the centre of the table with John resting his head on the table beside him, and the apostles around them.
days.look: Look again at the quiet table, and at John resting his head so close beside Jesus. Where in your home do you most need the peace Christ leaves us?
days.license: Artist died c. 1318; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Web Gallery of Art)

days.file: Sir Peter Paul Rubens, The Meeting of David and Abigail, c. 1630, NGA 99280.jpg
days.title: The Meeting of David and Abigail
days.alt: Abigail kneels before David with one hand open and a gentle face, and David bends toward her and takes her hand.
days.look: Look again at Abigail’s open hand and the way David leans down to her. What gentle word could you offer the next time voices begin to rise?
days.license: Artist died 1640; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: CC0, National Gallery of Art)

days.title: Jacob and Esau Meet
days.alt: Two brothers, Esau and Jacob, hold each other in a long embrace on the road while their families stand quietly around them.
days.look: Look again at the two brothers with their arms around each other, and at the families waiting beside them. Who is the person you most need to run toward?
days.license: Artist died 1883; engraving published 1866 (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Kwijtschelding van de schuld van de knecht door de koning Gelijkenis van de ondankbare knecht (serietitel), RP-P-OB-102.479.jpg
days.artist: Dirck Volckertsz. Coornhert after Maarten van Heemskerck
days.title: The King Forgives the Servant's Debt (Parable of the Unforgiving Servant)
days.alt: A king in a crown holds out his open hand toward a servant who kneels with his hands joined, as the king forgives his debt.
days.look: Look again at the king’s open hand and the servant kneeling before it. How much has been forgiven you, and what would you forgive in return?

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Return of the Prodigal Son (Le retour de l'enfant prodigue) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
days.alt: A father in a yellow and grey robe wraps his arms around his ragged son, who clings to him, while the family watches from the stairs.
days.look: Look again at the father’s arms closing around his son, and the son’s hands holding on. Who is waiting for you to take the first step home?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Brooklyn Museum)

days.file: Gerard David - The Marriage at Cana.jpg
days.title: The Marriage at Cana
days.alt: At the wedding feast, Mary, in a white veil, bows her head toward Jesus, who raises His hand in blessing, while someone at the table holds a jug.
days.look: Look again at Mary bowing toward her Son, and at the jug held ready at the table. What need in your family could you bring to Jesus as simply as she does?
days.license: Artist died 1523; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Nicolaes Moeyaert - Abraham and Lot Divide the Land.jpg
days.title: Abraham Gives Lot the Choice of the Land
days.alt: Abraham and his nephew Lot stand close together among their flocks, talking calmly as one of them points toward the land ahead.
days.look: Look again at the two kinsmen standing close, one pointing the way and the other listening. Where could you yield on something small, and where do you need to stand firm?
days.license: Artist died 1655; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt, The Holy Family with a Curtain, 1646, Museum Schloss Wilhelmshöhe, Kassel.jpg
days.title: The Holy Family with a Curtain
days.alt: In a dim room lit by a small fire, Mary holds the child Jesus close while Joseph works quietly in the background and a cat sleeps by the hearth.
days.look: Look again at Mary holding the child, the small fire, and Joseph at his work in the shadows. What would help your home feel this quiet and thankful?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
